description: This Java source file defines the CompressedDDataHandler class, which manages distributed hash collections for compressed pub/sub topics, including creation, hashing, and compression functionalities.

classes.name: CompressedDDataHandler
classes.description: A distributed collection handler for hashed string data, supporting compression and creation within an Akka actor system.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initializes a new CompressedDDataHandler with specified actor system, data config, topic type, and pub/sub config.

methods.name: getSeeds
methods.description: Returns the list of hash seeds used for hashing.

methods.name: approximate
methods.description: Compresses a topic string into a ByteString of hash codes.

methods.name: hashCodesToByteString
